body.en: https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/pipe-length-d_744.html concrete pump distance range meaning Three compact concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai list distance as a range. Where the hyphen appears Output on these pages is also a range: 8–10, 6–12 and 5–8 m³/h. Electric 20 lists 120 m / 40 m the same way. Quoting only 80 m for Electric 15 drops the listed 60–80 m horizontal range and ignores the separate vertical range. It is the horizontal span listed on Electric 15. Does Diesel 30 use a hyphenated distance? Read the row title.
body.zh: https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/pipe-length-d_744.html混凝土泵距离写成范围是什么意思河北品锦机械在邢台的三台紧凑混凝土泵把距离写成范围。连字符不是可以单独引用的唯一上限，也不同于电动20那一组 120 m / 40 m。农村页仍是两个标题：水平 30–50 m，垂直 10–30 m。柴油30印 60 m / 180 m，两个数字内部都没有连字符。不要怎样使用上限60–80 m 是一个数还是一段区间？河北品锦机械在邢台的拖拉机带动4100混凝土泵。产量范围和距离范围是同一列吗？用连字符写成的泵送距离范围是什么意思，河北品锦机械，河北邢台

body.en: What a Hyphenated Pumping-Distance Range Means Electric 15 lists vertical 15–20 m and horizontal 60–80 m. Electric 15 splits the ranges across two labels. Keep the output range and the distance range on their own lines. Those are single pairs, not ranges. Quoting only 100 m for the tractor drops 40–100 m and the vertical 15–45 m. Both ends are part of the cell. No. Diesel 30 lists a single pair, 60 m / 180 m. What a Hyphenated Pumping-Distance Range Means, Hebei Pinjin Machinery, Xingtai, Hebei
body.zh: 用连字符写成的泵送距离范围是什么意思电动15的垂直为 15–20 m，水平为 60–80 m。连字符出现在哪里这几页的产量也是范围：8–10、6–12 和 5–8 m³/h。电动20的 120 m / 40 m 也是这样。只引用电动15的 80 m，会丢掉写出的水平 60–80 m，也会忽略单独的垂直范围。它是电动15写出的水平区间。柴油30的距离用连字符吗？不是。

body.en: Electric 15, the tractor pump and the rural diesel pump list distance as a range. The Tractor-Driven 4100 lists 40–100 m / 15–45 m. The tractor page puts both ranges inside one H / V cell: 40–100 m / 15–45 m. What a single pair looks like beside them Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not tell you to average a range or to advertise only the upper end. If a job needs one guaranteed metre the cell does not isolate, use /en/contact/. Which pump lists 40–100 m / 15–45 m? Are output ranges the same column as distance ranges?
body.zh: 电动15、拖拉机泵和农村柴油泵把距离写成范围。拖拉机带动4100为 40–100 m / 15–45 m。电动15把范围分在两个标题下。产量范围和距离范围要留在各自的行上。它们是单组数字，不是范围。只引用拖拉机的 100 m，会丢掉 40–100 m 和垂直 15–45 m。两端都属于这一格。不用。它们在不同的行上。

body.en: A range is not the same notation as a single pair. The rural diesel pump lists horizontal 30–50 m and vertical 10–30 m. The rural page again uses two labels, 30–50 m horizontal and 10–30 m vertical. Diesel 30 lists 60 m / 180 m with no hyphen inside either number. What not to do with the top number Is 60–80 m one number or a span? The Tractor-Driven 4100 concrete pump from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. No. They sit on different rows.
body.zh: 范围和单组数字不是同一种写法。农村柴油泵的水平为 30–50 m，垂直为 10–30 m。拖拉机页把两个范围放进同一个水平/垂直格：40–100 m / 15–45 m。旁边的单组数字长什么样河北品锦机械没有让你把范围取平均，或只宣传上限。如果工况需要格子没有单独给出的一个保证米数，请用 /zh/contact/。哪台泵印 40–100 m / 15–45 m？柴油30印的是单组 60 m / 180 m。请读行标题。

question.en: Is 60–80 m one number or a span?
question.zh: 60–80 m 是一个数还是一段区间？

answer.en: It is the horizontal span listed on Electric 15. Both ends are part of the cell.
answer.zh: 它是电动15写出的水平区间。两端都属于这一格。

answer.en: The Tractor-Driven 4100 concrete pump from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai.
answer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台的拖拉机带动4100混凝土泵。

question.en: Does Diesel 30 use a hyphenated distance?
question.zh: 柴油30的距离用连字符吗？

answer.en: No. Diesel 30 lists a single pair, 60 m / 180 m.
answer.zh: 不用。柴油30印的是单组 60 m / 180 m。

question.en: Are output ranges the same column as distance ranges?
question.zh: 产量范围和距离范围是同一列吗？

answer.en: No. They sit on different rows. Read the row title.
answer.zh: 不是。它们在不同的行上。请读行标题。
